entities.name: Application Layer Measurement Reporting Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE to report application layer measurements in RRC_CONNECTED state when configured with application layer measurement configuration.

entities.name: MeasurementReportAppLayer
entities.description: RRC message used to report application layer measurements from UE to network.

entities.name: measConfigAppLayerId
entities.description: Identifier for application layer measurement configuration.

entities.name: measReportAppLayerContainer
entities.description: Container for application layer measurement report received from upper layers.

entities.name: appLayerSessionStatus
entities.description: Indicates session start or stop status for application layer measurement.

entities.name: appLayerBufferLevelList
entities.description: List of application layer buffer level values in chronological order.

entities.name: initialPlayoutDelay
entities.description: Initial playout delay value from RAN visible application layer measurement report.

entities.name: pdu-SessionIdList
entities.description: List of PDU session IDs indicated in RAN visible application layer measurement report.

entities.name: Application Layer Measurement Reporting Not Suspended
entities.description: Condition that application layer measurement reporting has not been suspended for the measConfigAppLayerId.

entities.name: RRC Message Segmentation Required
entities.description: Condition when RRC message segmentation is enabled and encoded message exceeds PDCP SDU maximum size.

entities.name: UL Message Segment Transfer Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for transferring uplink message segments when RRC message segmentation is required.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC connected state where UE can perform application layer measurement reporting.

relations.description: Procedure can only be initiated when UE is in RRC_CONNECTED state.
Procedure includes submitting MeasurementReportAppLayer message to lower layers.
MeasurementReportAppLayer message contains appLayerSessionStatus IE when session status information is received.
MeasurementReportAppLayer message contains appLayerBufferLevelList IE when RAN visible buffer level reports are received.
MeasurementReportAppLayer message contains initialPlayoutDelay IE when received in RAN visible measurement report.
MeasurementReportAppLayer message contains pdu-SessionIdList IE when PDU session IDs are indicated.
Procedure execution is guarded by condition that measurement reporting is not suspended.
When RRC segmentation is required, UL message segment transfer procedure is initiated.
